_doc: Sector hazards (scripts/combat/hazards.gd, README 'Hazards'). Some nodes of a region have one of the region's `hazards` (data/regions/*.json); it changes HOW you fight there. `chances`: per node type, the chance a node in a region that lists hazards has one (`default` for a type not listed; stations, the exit and dead gates never). The roll picks evenly among the region's hazards and a direction (`dir`: degrees, 0 east, 90 south, as sector.gd; it points TOWARD the star or UPSTREAM, to where the debris comes from), once per node (Hazards.roll: the region seed and the node alone). `hazards`: id -> name, the one-line HUD text (`hud`), a one-letter map glyph and a colour, plus its numbers. A wall 'faces' the hazard when an exposed face of it has a normal within `face_dot` (a cosine, 0.5 = 60 degrees) of `dir`. ion_storm: shield layers come back at `recharge_mult` of the usual speed (the ion lock timer is not slowed). star_heat: every `every_s` a flare lights up to `fires` fires on each ship, on floor cells beside the outer walls that face the star; the HUD warns `warn_s` before. gas_cloud: every turret's accuracy changes by `accuracy_add` (hit chance 0..1), and the enemy pilot's aim error is multiplied by `aim_error_mult`. radiation: while a ship has no shield layer up (none left, or the shields ion-locked), every crew member aboard without the `suit` trait loses `hp_per_s`. debris_surge: every `every_s`, `hits` kinetic hits of `damage` land on random outer wall cells that face the current, on each ship, through the normal damage rules (resist, slopes, breaches). Timers run on the arena tick, so a fight starts with the first flare or surge `every_s` in.

ion_storm.name: Ion storm
ion_storm.hud: ION STORM: shields recharge at half speed

star_heat.name: Star heat
star_heat.hud: STAR HEAT: a flare every 25 s lights fires on the star side

gas_cloud.name: Gas cloud
gas_cloud.hud: GAS CLOUD: turrets -20% accuracy, enemy aim is worse

radiation.name: Radiation
radiation.hud: RADIATION: with no shield layer up, unsuited crew lose 0.5 hp/s

debris_surge.name: Debris surge
debris_surge.hud: DEBRIS SURGE: hits every 20 s on the side facing the current
